_readme: One entry per photo in this folder. 'focus' is the CSS object-position used when a layout crops the photo (e.g. '50% 30%' = keep the area a bit above centre). 'alt' describes the photo for screen readers. Add a new photo by dropping it in this folder, adding an entry here, then running: npm run photos
